name: Baseline Measurement

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

primaryTarget: wasm/web with headed Playwright and WebGPU enabled
hypothesisMarkdown:
## Baseline Measurement

Measure and document the starting point for this improvement loop before making optimization changes.
measurementPlanMarkdown:
### Measurement Plan

Run the frozen headed Test Suite WASM/WebGPU matrix at DPR 1, 1.25, 1.5, and 2. Record matched RayX/DOM acutance, chromatic fringe, physical alignment, native-DPR backing dimensions, and thirty-sample warm timing summaries. Inspect the existing glyph ownership and diagnostics surfaces without changing production rendering.
expectedOutcomeMarkdown:
### Expected Outcome

Baseline metrics are captured and stored so later experiments compare against a known starting point.

playwright: The focused headed-WebGPU matrix completed its baseline capture and diagnostic-privacy tests; the frozen quality target failed with the expected matched DOM quality target unmet predicate.
rayx: The active WASM path reports grayscale monochrome glyph coverage; browser subpixel support remains disabled and native-DPR canvas allocation is preserved.
counters: DPR 1: min acutance ratio 0.80456135, warm p50 9.99 ms, warm p95 10.01 ms, backing 1440x1320.
DPR 1.25: min acutance ratio 0.87, warm p50 10.00 ms, warm p95 10.02 ms, backing 1800x1650.
DPR 1.5: min acutance ratio 0.97, warm p50 9.99 ms, warm p95 10.07 ms, backing 2160x1980.
DPR 2: min acutance ratio 1.03, warm p50 10.00 ms, warm p95 10.11 ms, backing 2880x2640.
Maximum RayX chromatic-fringe ratio is 0 at every density; maximum physical alignment delta is 2 pixels.

reportMarkdown:
## Baseline Report

The mandatory baseline reproduced the intended red gate. Low-density text is the localized problem: DPR 1 reaches only 0.8046 of matched DOM acutance, while DPR 1.5 and 2 already exceed the 0.90 target. Chromatic-fringe energy remains zero and native-DPR backing dimensions remain exact. The worst DPR 1 cells are the smallest normal-weight specimens, not a broad geometry or scale failure. Read-only AST complexity scanning found broad renderer/font-database leads but no proven text-quality mechanism, so none enters the candidate ladder.

The current quality target reads the immutable Sprint 1 baseline rather than the just-captured candidate metrics. That is a measurement-publication gap: a renderer improvement cannot pass the target until the test consumes its current in-memory capture. The next atomic experiment will repair only that measurement path before any rasterization candidate is attempted.
decisionMarkdown:
### Decision

Accept the baseline as a successful measurement-only experiment. Make no production rendering change. Preserve the fixed candidate order, but first run one measurement-enablement experiment so each later candidate is judged from its current capture rather than the immutable baseline artifact.
notes: Baseline target failure was expected and matched exactly. No application other than apps/test_suite was launched.
